summary: Full-stack test for Eayadati (عيادتي) dental clinic SaaS. Backend: 37/37 pytest tests pass covering auth (login/register/JWT), RBAC financial gating (assistant blocked when show_financials_to_assistants=false, allowed when true), patients CRUD + search, dental chart upsert, x-ray upload/list/download via token (Emergent Object Storage integration working), appointments CRUD, invoices CRUD with kind filter, inventory + low-stock, lab orders CRUD, dashboard summary (net_profit + 6-month breakdown for doctor, hidden for assistant), assistant management. Frontend (Expo web, mobile viewport 390x844, RTL Arabic): login works with prefilled demo creds, doctor dashboard shows full financial summary (revenue 130, purchases 150, salaries 500, expenses 80, net_profit -600, monthly bar chart), assistant dashboard correctly hides financials with lock UI 'التقارير المالية مخفية' and invoices tab shows padlock 'ليس لديك صلاحية عرض الفواتير المالية'. Seeded patients (محمد علي/فاطمة الزهراء/خالد الحسن) and appointments render correctly in tabs. Tab navigation (الرئيسية/المرضى/المواعيد/الفواتير/المزيد) functional. RTL layout perfect. Minor RN-Web deprecation warnings observed only.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-breaking but should migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow (or use platform-specific style) for future RN Web compatibility.
React Native Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents from prop to style object.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow across StyleSheet definitions to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
(Optional/minor) Move pointerEvents from JSX prop to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 792 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, patients.py, invoices.py, storage.py, reports.py) for maintainability.

Storage key init (_init_storage) uses module-level _storage_key without a lock; under concurrent first-request load two threads could double-init. Low risk in single-worker uvicorn but worth an asyncio.Lock or threading.Lock.
Tenant isolation is correctly enforced from JWT (user['tenant_id']) on all mutating endpoints — no tenant_id accepted from request body. Verified across patients/appointments/invoices/inventory/lab.
Financial gating is correctly implemented via can_view_financials() checking role + tenant.show_financials_to_assistants for both /invoices and /reports/summary.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Backend auto-seeds demo tenant on startup. Test-created TEST_* records cleaned up in fixtures/teardown. One orphan TEST_XR patient from an aborted pre-fix run was cleaned up manually via API.
